report.answer_text:
Erling Haaland holds the record. He scored 36 goals in 35 appearances for Manchester City in 2022-23.[1]
His total beat the old record. The previous mark of 34 was shared by Alan Shearer and Andrew Cole.[1]
Those two set their totals in 42-game seasons. That was before the league shrank from 22 teams to 20 in 1995, so today's seasons are 38 games.[1]
In a 38-game season, the next best is Mohamed Salah, with 32 goals for Liverpool in 2017–18.[2]
Top single-season totals:
| Goals | Player | Season |
|---|---|---|
| 36 | Erling Haaland (Man City) | 2022-23 |
| 34 | Alan Shearer (Blackburn) | 1994-95 |
| 34 | Andy Cole (Newcastle) | 1993-94 |
| 32 | Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) | 2017-18 |
| 31 | Luis Suárez (Liverpool) | 2013-14 |
Cristiano Ronaldo also scored 31 in 2007–08.[2]
The 2026-27 season is still in progress, so the record could change in May.
